decisions.reason: As a multi-item facial care line that is very close to the firm's existing skincare know-how and remained prominently presented in both 2023 and 2024, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

This serum is also close to the firm's established facial-care competence and stayed on the website across both years, so the firm is likely able to interpret market feedback and retain it despite some uncertainty from limited visible R&D information.

Although newer and less proven because it appeared only in 2024, the cleansing oil is still strongly related to the firm's core natural facial-care business, which makes continued learning and refinement more likely than early withdrawal.
